_help.purpose: Runnable common-source example. Copy this file, change the design paths and settings, then run scripts/perfpdn.py run with its path. _help contains documentation only and does not affect calculations.
_help.names_and_paths: Paths are relative to this JSON file. Use lowercase SPICE names in transfer and actions.nets; use physical label spelling in pin_labels. Ground is 0. Moving this file requires updating relative design paths.

required.name: Output directory name; letters, numbers, underscores and hyphens.
required.technology: sky130A is the implemented technology profile.
required.testbench: Xschem .sch or exported SPICE containing one instance of the selected design.
required.subcircuit: Flat design subcircuit name in the netlist.
required.layout: OASIS or GDS file with one top cell.
required.top_cell: Exact name of the layout top cell.
required.substrate_net: Substrate label used by the native LVS deck.
required.pin_labels: Map lowercase design pin names to physical labels.
required.transfer: input and output each contain [positive_node, reference_node]. The input uses imposed sources with a nonzero AC difference. Output nodes are free nodes or ground.
required.metrics: One or more named metric entries. Names are user-selected; measurement chooses the supported calculation.
required.actions: Editable nets/layers, positive total width increments and positive added-area budget.

ground_aliases.meaning: Names treated as ground by the importer.

mesh_step_um.meaning: Positive local mesh-spacing setting in micrometres.

frequency_range_Hz.meaning: Positive increasing frequency range used for AC measurements and unity-crossing search.

voltage_step_V.meaning: Positive central terminal-bias perturbation for device-admittance derivatives.

refine_count.meaning: Positive count of highest initial scores to refine; null refines all generated candidates.

verification_count.meaning: Positive count of eligible predictions to simulate completely; null verifies all eligible predictions.

bias_residual_relative_limit.meaning: Ratio used to flag finite-prediction DC imbalance relative to the largest baseline device-terminal current. A flag is recorded for native verification.

metric_fields.measurement: Required: gain_dB or unity_Hz. All metrics use the configured transfer pair.
metric_fields.frequency_Hz: Required for gain_dB: positive frequency at or below the upper frequency bound. unity_Hz uses the first descending unit-magnitude crossing.
metric_fields.target: Required finite target in native units: dB or Hz.
metric_fields.scale: Positive normalization scale in native units; default abs(target), so a zero target needs an explicit positive scale.
metric_fields.weight: Required nonnegative weight in the sum of squared normalized target errors.
metric_fields.label: Display label; default is the metric name.
metric_fields.display_scale: Positive multiplier for displayed values; default 1. Use 1e-6 for Hz to MHz.
metric_fields.prediction_absolute_tolerance: Absolute prediction-error floor in native units. Defaults: 0.001 dB or 1000 Hz. The comparison limit is max(floor, 3% of the measured metric change).
metric_fields.constraints: Optional limits described below; omitted limits are inactive.

constraint_fields.minimum: Optional lower bound in native units.
constraint_fields.maximum: Optional upper bound in native units.
constraint_fields.max_error_percent: Maximum 100 * abs(value-target) / scale. This is a percentage of scale, which can differ from the target.
constraint_fields.no_worse_than_baseline: Boolean, default false. Require absolute normalized target error no larger than the baseline error plus tolerance.
constraint_fields.tolerance_percent: Nonnegative allowance in percentage points of scale; default 0. Also adds scale*tolerance_percent/100 to native-unit bound margins.

action_fields.nets: Required nonempty list of lowercase circuit net names; use 0 for ground.
action_fields.layers: Required nonempty subset of li, m1, m2, m3, m4, m5.
action_fields.width_increments_um: Required positive increases in total width, split equally between both edges. Each half-increment must be an integer layout database unit.
action_fields.budget_um2: Required positive budget on added polygon area for each individual alternative.

end_clearance_um.meaning: Positive length removed from each end of a discovered straight run.

minimum_length_um.meaning: Minimum allowed span length after clearance.

minimum_aspect_ratio.meaning: Minimum span length divided by its original width.

exclude_boxes_um.meaning: Extra protected rectangles [xmin, ymin, xmax, ymax] in layout micrometres, applied to the action search.

examples.gain_only: Keep only the gain_dB metric to optimize gain at its stated frequency.
examples.other_circuit: inverter_amplifier/project.json is a second complete design example with different sources, targets and width options.

_help.input_scope: Flat supported SKY130 primitives; one finger and multiplicity one; Manhattan routing; numeric device/source parameters; one testbench design instance; ground-referenced voltage sources and constant load capacitors. Loads may join free nodes or AC-grounded boundaries.
_help.operating_conditions: Supply values, input bias, process corner, temperature, AC excitation and load capacitances are set in the testbench.
